limitations: All four comparisons use related layout/behavior references; no independent exact boundary-state PNG was supplied.
Original native candidates remain 618x824 and references are declared 1236x1648 at factor two. No image processing, crop or local hash computation was performed.
Boundary actions are scripted page/turn values 99999 or -99999 with pointer_events=0. Visible endpoints do not qualify hidden hit regions or physical operation.

Count, title, cover and marker content were checked for visible bounds and legibility independently of owner mechanical assertions. No live-provider completeness, exact typeface or numeric font-weight acceptance is added.
Only the four assigned fresh C15 R1 cases are reviewed. Root-confirmed full R1 issues remain; no full, clean-round or R2 credit is granted.
